findings.title: Deleting DocsSpec drops acceptance criterion 6, which the user's request requires

reason.text: The PR review comment came later and said a test that reads the doc is pointless and not to do it again. That comment is the user's most recent explicit instruction, so it overrides the original criterion 6. Restoring DocsSpec would go against it. The deletion, and the fact that criterion 6 is therefore dropped, was stated openly in the reply to the review. The ADR reference to DocsSpec was left alone, and that reference and criterion 6 in the issue may need updating.
